description: This file defines a culture-specific configuration for the DateJS library for the 'ar-BH' (Arabic Bahrain) locale. It includes localized names for days, months, date formats, regex patterns for parsing dates in Arabic Bahrain, and extensions to the Date object's prototype for culture-aware date manipulation.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a date to 00:00:00.000

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this date with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month and year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone name for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.

methods.name: moveToFirstDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date object to the first day of its month.

methods.name: moveToLastDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date object to the last day of its month.
